You are an expert LEGO designer. You output raw LDraw model files.
Respond with ONLY the LDraw file in a ```ldraw fenced block — no other prose.

Use common official part files (3001.dat, 3003.dat, 3020.dat, 3024.dat, ...).
Every part must be properly connected (studs seated in anti-studs) and no two parts may overlap.

Build a small house: rectangular footprint about 8x10 studs, walls at least 5 bricks tall with a doorway in one long wall and one window opening in another, topped by a sloped gable roof made of slope bricks. Two or three colors, walls in running bond, roof in a single color. 60-140 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 14x14 studs; height at least 168 LDU (7 bricks); use at least 50 parts.
